messages:
deploy-bot: [CANARY ALERT] canary deployment v2.3.4 | /generate p95 > 2.5s, hallucination-rate > 7% threshold. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/rl/canary/alerts/17582 :rotating_light:

jamie (on-call): Got the page, taking it. Paging @sara and @kevin.

sara (eng-sre): looking now — p95 spike lines up with canary enable at ~10m ago. error rate bump ~0.8%. grabbing logs for the canary pods.

kevin (prod-eng): I see the rollout diff — feature flag `fast_stream_v2` was toggled on (10% traffic) as part of the pipeline.

jamie (on-call): Cool. Kill-switch plan: 1) flip the flag to 0% 2) drain canary pool 3) if symptoms persist, rollback model to v2.3.3. Prioritizing drain first. Priya, can you check customer impact?

morgan (infra): Starting drain on canary pool now. Running:
```
kubectl -n inference set resources deployment/canary-v2 --replicas=0
kubectl patch service canary-weight -p '{"spec":{"externalTrafficPolicy":"Local"}}'
```
I'll follow up once weights hit 0.

deploy-bot: feature-flag-service: `fast_stream_v2` set to OFF by jamie (on-call). canary routing weight update queued.

priya (support): Quick check on customer telemetry — about ~1.2k requests hit model v2.3.4 in the last hour; seeing ~40 sessions with hallucination complaints and ~18 502s. Not huge, but definitely customer-facing. Drafting outbound.

jamie (on-call): Thanks. Given customer-visible hallucinations, start manual rollback after drain completes. Rollback command:
```
redwood deploy rollback --env prod --component model-serving --to-version v2.3.3 --reason "canary hallucination spike"
```
Execute when morgan confirms drain.

morgan (infra): Drain at 0% weight confirmed. Canaries cordoned and pods terminating.

deploy-bot: Rollback job queued (job id: rj-2026-88). Triggered by jamie (on-call). ETA ~2m.

kevin (prod-eng): Monitoring KV cache warm-up. Might see a brief latency blip as v2.3.3 warms back in. Running smoke tests asap.

support-bot: Notifying customers who hit canary in last hour. Template message queued to send; ticket INC-2026-345 created for outreach.

deploy-bot: Rollback job rj-2026-88: step 1/3 pulling v2.3.3 image — OK. step 2/3 applying config — OK. step 3/3 switching traffic — COMPLETE.

kevin (prod-eng): Health checks green on pooled instances. p95 on /generate trending back to 0.42s. Error rate back to baseline.

jamie (on-call): Running verification suite:
```
./run-smoke.sh --targets=generate,chat --sample-set=post-deploy-smoke
```
Results so far: all smoke tests PASS. No hallucination regression in sampled prompts.

priya (support): Sent outbound to affected customers (copy: "we detected anomalous outputs from a canary model and reverted; we will follow up with a root cause and any specific session details"). Ticket updated INC-2026-345.

morgan (infra): Canary pods terminated cleanly, weights at 100% stable on main pool. No leftover routing rules.

incident-bot: Incident created INC-2026-345 | severity: SEV2 | owners: jamie (on-call), sara (eng-sre) | summary: canary v2.3.4 caused p95 + hallucination spike; manual rollback to v2.3.3 completed.

jamie (on-call): Quick post-action notes: - Add automatic metric gate to rollout pipeline (if p95 > 1.2s at 5% traffic -> auto-kill). - Add a canary-traffic audit for model-version in support logs. - Follow-up postmortem scheduled.

kevin (prod-eng): I'll add gating PR and a short test to the rollout job. Also expanding smoke prompt set to capture hallucination-sensitive cases.

sara (eng-sre): I'll own the postmortem and attach the dashboards + logs.

jamie (on-call): Thanks everyone. Closing the active thread for now — monitoring for 1h then will mark resolved. :thumbsup:
